Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Oviedo for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Photos with Santa at Oviedo Mall) through December 21, with Breakfast with Santa (December 5), the Oviedo Santa Run (December 14 to 18) and Campfire Christmas (December 21) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
